job_id.Description: The `job_id` of the `jobs.tsv` row this path belongs to.

path.Description: The asset's path, relative to the root of the Dandiset holding the capsule. Where it sits beneath the capsule directory says which mapping it belongs to. The dataset description is `dataset_description.json`, outputs are under `derivatives/` and logs are under `logs/`.

content_id.Description: The DANDI content identifier of the asset at `path`.
